annotated_source_quotes.text: Wow, that's great! It sure shows how important friendship and compassion are. cases.question: What was Melanie's reaction to her children enjoying the Grand Canyon?
cases.luna: She was thankful they enjoyed it.
cases.sol: Joy and gratitude for her family

annotated_source_quotes.speaker: Melanie
annotated_source_quotes.text: Yeah, you're right, Caroline. Family's super important to me. Especially after the accident, I've thought a lot about how much I need them. cases.question: What does Melanie do with her family on hikes?
cases.sol: Explore nature and forests, enjoy mountain views, learn about nature, bond with each other

annotated_source_quotes.speaker: Melanie
annotated_source_quotes.text: We always look forward to our family camping trip. We roast marshmallows, tell stories around the campfire and just enjoy each other's company. It's the highlight of our summer! [Shared image caption (automatic): a photo of a fire pit with a lot of fire and sparks]

annotated_source_quotes.speaker: Melanie
annotated_source_quotes.text: Thanks, Caroline! It's awesome seeing the kids get excited learning something new about nature. Those moments make being a parent worth it.
